scope: 44 exact FP-related variants in verification/elementwise-compiler/IntrinsicRegistry.json; read-only three-layer audit of kernel call sites, pinned-authority metadata/selectors, and Lean value implementations
limitations: The pinned ACLE/ISA source files named by IntrinsicAudit.json are not present in this checkout; selectors, prototypes, revisions, line numbers and hashes were checked through the content-bound IntrinsicAudit artifact. Thus confirmed means confirmed for pure active-lane value/bit semantics, not flags, traps, C memory, or compiled ISA semantics.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE advsimd.csv@c218a6b line 1616, FABS Vd.4S,Vn.4S
rows.finding: Kernel operand order is unary and Lean clears only bit 31. This matches the pure bit-value behavior used by the two kernels, including signed zero and NaN payload preservation.
rows.next_action: Add direct Arm DN=0/DN=1 and signaling-NaN hardware probes before extending the claim to FP state modes.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE advsimd.csv@c218a6b line 35, FADD Vd.4S,Vn.4S,Vm.4S
rows.finding: NaN priority, quieting, invalid infinity and canonical invalid result are explicitly separated for Arm DN=0/AH=0. The nonexceptional path still delegates to opaque host Float32.add, with no independent exhaustive oracle for subnormals, tie rounding, signed zero, overflow or underflow.
rows.next_action: Differentially sweep structured FP32 boundary pairs against AArch64 FADD under RN,FZ=0,DN=0,AH=0; include flags as separately observed data.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE advsimd.csv@c218a6b line 1834, BSL Vd.16B,Vn.16B,Vm.16B
rows.finding: Argument order is mask,true,false and Lean implements exact bit selection per lane. It is insensitive to NaN, signed zero and rounding.
rows.next_action: Retain a mask mutation test and random bit-pattern differential test.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE line 669, FACGT Vd.4S,Vm.4S,Vn.4S; conditions FZ=0 and traps disabled
rows.finding: The reversed FACGT selector is correctly modeled as abs(left) < abs(right); NaNs produce false and signed zeros compare equal. FPSR/invalid behavior is intentionally absent, so adequacy depends on the recorded FZ/trap/value-only scope.
rows.next_action: Probe qNaN/sNaN, both signed zeros, infinities and smallest subnormals on AArch64, recording both mask and FPSR.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE line 1243, SCVTF Vd.4S,Vn.4S; RN/FZ=0/traps-off conditions
rows.finding: Operand wiring is correct, but all i32-to-f32 rounding is delegated to host Float32.ofInt. No independent check establishes all 2^32 inputs or the 24-bit precision boundaries under Arm RN.
rows.next_action: Use a mathematically exact integer-to-binary32 oracle or exhaust all i32 values by exponent buckets against AArch64 SCVTF.

rows.finding: Left/right order and NaN/0/0/inf/inf cases are explicit. Finite division, divide-by-zero sign, subnormal and correctly-rounded last-bit behavior still rely on host Float32.div.
rows.next_action: Boundary-pair and randomized AArch64 FDIV comparison, including ±0, smallest subnormals, exact half-ULP cases and all exception classes.

rows.finding: The scalar is replicated bit-for-bit to four logical lanes; call signatures and argument order match. C scalar evaluation/NaN representation remains outside the pure-value model.
rows.next_action: Keep a bit-pattern broadcast test including negative zero and NaN payload.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE line 2055, high 64-bit half selector
rows.finding: Lean/compiler structural extraction preserves lanes 2 and 3 in order and does not interpret FP bits.
rows.next_action: Retain lane-order mutation regression.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: ACLE line 2070, low 64-bit half selector
rows.finding: Lean/compiler structural extraction preserves lanes 0 and 1 in order and does not interpret FP bits.
rows.next_action: Retain lane-order mutation regression.

rows.finding: One 32-bit memory value is loaded and replicated; pointer order is correct. Alignment, faults, volatile and C alias behavior are outside the current logical-value claim.
rows.next_action: Add memory-refinement checks when upgrading from logical list semantics.

rows.finding: Four consecutive 32-bit lanes are loaded in order and remain raw bits in the logical model.
rows.next_action: Separate future alignment/fault/alias audit from this value verdict.

rows.finding: Lean propagates selected NaN payload with signaling-NaN priority and returns +0 for mixed signed zeros. This matches the reviewed DN=0/AH=0 value scope; flags/traps and alternative FPCR modes are excluded.
rows.next_action: Hardware matrix for qNaN/sNaN operand priority, ±0 order and DN/AH toggles.

rows.finding: Lean propagates selected NaN payload with signaling-NaN priority and returns -0 for mixed signed zeros. Adequacy is limited to the explicit FPCR pure-value scope.
rows.next_action: Hardware matrix for qNaN/sNaN operand priority, ±0 order and DN/AH toggles.

rows.finding: NaN propagation and 0*infinity invalid are explicit, but every normal/subnormal finite product and final rounding comes from host Float32.mul.
rows.next_action: Compare exponent-stratified products against AArch64 FMUL/SoftFloat under RN,FZ=0, including underflow ties and signed zero.

rows.finding: No bits or lane order change; the source and destination type views are correctly wired.
rows.next_action: Keep round-trip arbitrary-bit theorem/test.

rows.finding: Exact 128-bit register bits and lane order are preserved.

rows.finding: Exact FP32 encodings become unsigned lane values without conversion.

rows.finding: NaN quieting and negative-nonzero invalid are explicit. Positive finite and subnormal square-root rounding is delegated to host Float32.sqrt.

rows.finding: Two low-half logical lanes are stored in order with raw FP bits preserved.
rows.next_action: Defer alignment/fault/alias properties to the memory bridge.

rows.finding: Lane immediate domain and pointer,value,lane order are exact; current kernels select lane 0.

rows.finding: Four logical lanes are stored in order with exact bit patterns.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc@b611045 line 44180; ISA selector vfsgnjx.vv
rows.finding: RVV vfabs pseudoinstruction clears the sign bit through sign injection; Lean does exactly that and preserves NaN payload/signaling bits otherwise.
rows.next_action: Retain arbitrary-bit equivalence to x & 0x7fffffff.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc line 37832, ISA vfadd.vf; frm=RNE
rows.finding: Vector/scalar order and canonical NaN rule are modeled. Finite results rely on host add, scalar NaN-boxing is abstracted, and vl is erased into active-list length.
rows.next_action: RVV simulator/hardware comparison across boundary operands under RNE; explicitly test malformed NaN boxing only if widening beyond C float inputs.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc line 37830, ISA vfadd.vv; frm=RNE
rows.finding: Canonical NaNs and invalid infinity are explicit, but ordinary/subnormal arithmetic uses host Float32.add; inactive/tail lanes are omitted by the logical-list abstraction.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc line 45072, ISA vfcvt.f.x.v; frm=RNE
rows.finding: Correct source type and active-lane wiring, but all integer-to-float rounding is shared with Neon through host Float32.ofInt and has no architecture-independent proof.

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc line 45056, ISA vfcvt.x.f.v line 3824; frm=RNE

evidence: IntrinsicAudit.json: intrinsic_funcs.adoc line 39182, ISA vfdiv.vv; frm=RNE
rows.finding: Operand order, canonical NaN and invalid cases are explicit. Correct finite/subnormal quotient rounding and divide-by-zero flags remain host-dependent/outside scope.
